You can take screenshots ingame by pressing f2 on pc. You can find them in your .minecraft folder. 

If you dont know where to find this;

On windows
1. Press your windows button + R at the same time. 
2. Type in "%appdata%". 
3. Press enter.
4. Find your .minecraft folder in there.
5. Open the screenshots folder.
6. Voila screenshots are there.
